description: Jiri AI ọ bụla mepụta, debe ihe niile. Jụọ n’okwu ma ọ bụ jiri faịlụ, nweta ihe ị rịọrọ, emechara ya. Jiri GPT, Claude, Gemini ma ọ bụ AI dị na kọmputa gị; akụkọ gị, faịlụ gị na ihe ị chetara na-anọ na ngwaọrụ gị. N’efu, koodu ya mepere emepe.

sources.title: Ịhapụ ụlọ
pages:
Akwụkwọ mgbazinye ụlọ nwere arịa

Isiokwu 7. Ọkwa. Onye bi n’ụlọ nwere ike ịkwụsị mgbazinye mgbe ọ bụla site n’inye ọkwa otu ọnwa, e zitere n’akwụkwọ ozi edebanyere aha ma ọ bụ e nyere n’aka ka e nyechaa akwụkwọ nnata.
Isiokwu 9. Ego nchekwa. A na-eweghachi ego nchekwa ruru ụgwọ otu ọnwa n’ime otu ọnwa e weghachiri igodo, ewepụ ego mmezi ọ bụla.
sources.ask: Ọkwa ole ka m ga-enye iji pụọ, oleekwa mgbe m ga-enweta ego nchekwa m?
sources.answer:
Nke a bụ ihe akwụkwọ mgbazinye gị kwuru:

- **Ọkwa:** otu ọnwa, n’akwụkwọ ozi edebanyere aha ma ọ bụ e nyere n’aka ka e nyechaa akwụkwọ nnata [1].
- **Ego nchekwa:** a ga-eweghachi ya n’ime otu ọnwa e weghachiri igodo, ewepụ ego mmezi ọ bụla [1].

Ya bụ, ọ bụrụ na i zipu akwụkwọ ozi taa, ị nwere ike ịpụ n’otu ọnwa.
